    "languages": ["fr", "it"],

    "languages": ["la", "grc"],

    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "N (nun, fish in Hebrew) + V (vav, hook) + D (dalet, door) → fish-hook-door",
    "reading": "A hook that catches fish at the door — a threshold for spiritual sustenance.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "Sefer Yetzirah (letter correspondences)",
    "confidence": 0.35
  },

    "operation": "numerical",

    "reading": "The number 2 — polar opposition resolved, the twin peaks of snow and sun.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative (Pythagorean gematria)",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ne-vada; 'ne' (Sanskrit) = not; 'vada' (Sanskrit) = speech, claim → 'not speech'",
    "reading": "Silence — that which is beyond words, the unspeakable white stillness.",
    "languages": ["sa"],
    "source": "generative",

  {

    "reading": "A place of fords that do not go — a crossing that stands still, a frozen river.",
    "languages": ["la", "it"],
    "source": "generative",

    "reading": "A ford through snow — a crossing over white water, a pass in the high peaks.",

    "languages": ["la", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.25
  }
]
